title: Unmasking Nationality Bias: A Study of Human Perception of Nationalities in AI-Generated Articles

bias_targets.methodology: A mixed-methods human evaluation comparing AI-generated (GPT-2) articles to human-written articles. The quantitative approach uses annotators to score Overall Perception, Country Perception, Diagnosis Parameter (rudeness/disrespect), and Toxic Parameter (hate/aggression). The qualitative approach utilizes semi-structured interviews and thematic analysis to assess human perception and impact.
